Through: Mr. Ritesh Kumar Bahri, APP fo  State with SI AShutosh Mishra,
 Bhajanpura, Delhi.

CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 16.02.2023 1.

This petition has been filed for quashing for FIR No. 733/2021 registered at PS Bhajanpura under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide settlement dated 23rd March, 2022 arrived at with the facilitation with the Counselling Cell, Family Courts,
Karkardooma Courts, which is on record of this Court.

entities.text:
Counselling Cell, Family Courts,
Karkardooma Courts
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Petitioner No. 1 is present in Court and is duly identified by the counsel and the Investigating Officer.
2. Petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 2 were married but due to disputes and differences the marriage ended in divorce vide decree dated 11th October, 2022 which is also on record of this Court.
No child was born out of wedlock.
3. As per settlement balance amount of Rs.1 lac is to be paid to the respondent No. 2.

However,
respondent No. 2 is not present in Court today and informed the IO that she is unable to be present before the Court today.
4. In view of the same, list on 28th February.
Respondent No. 2 may be duly re-notifed by the IO to be present on the next date of hearing.
5. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J FEBRUARY 16, 2023/RK Kamal Kumar @
